title_zh: 任正非重申「华为不造车」，将继续帮助东风造好车
content_zh:
界面新闻 9 月 24 日报道，东风汽车总经理冯长军近日与华为创始人任正非会谈。东风方面转述，任正非表示，东风有造车基础，应发挥自身优势；

双方讨论了东风与华为共同打造的奕境 X9、猛士 X700 和岚图梦想家 9 等车型。奕境 X9 是双方合作品牌的首款旗舰车，东风此前介绍，该车全系搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5。任正非还建议东风改善面向用户的服务。

这次会谈发生在问界合作模式调整后。鸿蒙智行 9 月 15 日公布，问界的产品定义、设计、品牌营销、零售和服务由赛力斯主导，华为参与技术赋能。东风与华为目前仍围绕新车型推进合作。
title_en: Ren Zhengfei Reaffirms Huawei's "No Car-Making" Stance, Pledges Continued Support for Dongfeng
content_en:
Huawei founder Ren Zhengfei has reiterated that the tech giant will not manufacture cars itself, but will continue to assist Dongfeng Motor in building high-quality vehicles. The statement was made during a recent meeting between Ren and Dongfeng Motor General Manager Feng Changjun.

During the talks, the two executives discussed several co-developed models, including the Yijing X9, Mengshi X700, and Voyah Dreamer 9. The Yijing X9, the flagship model of their joint brand, will come fully equipped with Huawei's Qiankun ADS 5.0 intelligent driving system. Ren also advised Dongfeng to focus on improving its customer service.

This meeting comes shortly after a shift in Huawei's partnership model with Seres for the Aito (Wenjie) brand. Under the new arrangement announced on September 15, Seres will lead product definition, design, marketing, and sales, while Huawei shifts to a technical empowerment role. Despite this adjustment, Huawei and Dongfeng are actively pushing forward with their collaborative pipeline.

title_zh: 曝 DeepSeek 年化收入运行率达 10 亿美元，数月内翻倍
content_zh:
路透社 9 月 24 日引述《The Information》报道称，DeepSeek 的年化收入运行率已达约 10 亿美元，数月内增长超过一倍。年化收入运行率是按当前营收速度推算的一年收入，并非公司已经取得的全年营收；报道援引两名直接知情人士，DeepSeek 尚未公开披露相关财务数据。

报道称，创始人梁文锋近日在投资者会议上谈及最新收入规模。模型 API 提价是增长原因之一，相关价格上调了约 2.3 至 4.5 倍。DeepSeek 正推进第二轮融资，目标募资 500 亿元人民币，并争取在 10 月底前完成；该融资仍处于推进阶段。

路透社此前报道，DeepSeek 已聘请中信证券筹备在上海科创板上市，上市时间和融资规模尚未确定。此次 10 月底的时间节点指向第二轮融资，并非首次公开募股。
title_en: AI Startup DeepSeek's Annualized Revenue Run Rate Reportedly Hits $1 Billion, Doubling in Months
content_en:
Chinese AI startup DeepSeek has reportedly reached an annualized revenue run rate of approximately $1 billion, more than doubling its revenue pace within just a few months, according to *The Information*. The run rate is an extrapolation of current sales and does not represent actual full-year revenue. DeepSeek has not yet publicly disclosed its financial data.

Company founder Liang Wenfeng reportedly shared these figures during a recent investor meeting. The rapid growth is partly attributed to price hikes for the company's model APIs, which have increased by 2.3 to 4.5 times.

DeepSeek is currently advancing its second round of funding, aiming to raise 50 billion RMB (approximately $7.1 billion) by the end of October. While previous reports indicated that the company has hired CITIC Securities to prepare for an IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market, the upcoming October deadline specifically targets this private funding round rather than the public listing.

title_zh: 网易云音乐鸿蒙版正式上线，支持歌单同步与多终端使用
content_zh:
网易云音乐鸿蒙版已正式上线，华为手机用户可在应用市场下载。新版本覆盖手机、折叠屏和平板，播放与社区互动均已适配，原账号的歌单、收藏和播放历史保持互通。

相较此前的尝鲜版，正式版补上本地音乐导入、播放器样式切换、音质音效设置和深色模式，也支持乐评、歌单收藏与云村笔记。应用针对折叠屏与平板分别调整布局，并提供桌面卡片和系统级播控。

鸿蒙用户此前主要通过安卓兼容方式运行网易云音乐。原生版上线后，播放控制与后台运行可直接接入鸿蒙系统能力；网易云音乐与华为团队此前根据测试反馈持续迭代应用。
title_en: NetEase Cloud Music Launches Native HarmonyOS App with Multi-Device Sync
content_en:
NetEase Cloud Music has officially launched its native HarmonyOS version, now available for download on the Huawei AppGallery. The new release is fully optimized for smartphones, foldable devices, and tablets, allowing seamless synchronization of playlists, favorites, and playback history across devices.

Compared to the previous beta version, the official release introduces several key features, including local music importing, customizable player styles, audio quality settings, and dark mode. It also supports core community features such as music reviews, playlist saving, and "Cloud Village" notes. The app features tailored layouts for foldables and tablets, alongside desktop widgets and system-level playback controls.

Previously, HarmonyOS users relied on Android compatibility to run NetEase Cloud Music. With the launch of the native version, the app can now directly leverage HarmonyOS system capabilities for smoother background operation and more responsive playback controls.

title_zh: 余承东回应问界调整：赛力斯主动提出主导，华为将聚焦其余四界
content_zh:
9 月 24 日，余承东在合肥鸿蒙智行门店谈及问界合作模式调整时表示，赛力斯经过多年合作，能力已有长足成长，主动提出希望自己主导问界，华为选择支持。这是双方 9 月中旬公布新分工后，余承东对调整缘由的公开回应。

同日，余承东发文称，接下来华为团队会聚焦尊界、享界、智界和尚界，让四个品牌获得更充足的资源，团队也有更多精力打磨产品和体验。他还提到，近期在江淮工厂参与尊界大型 SUV 的造型评审，并预告智界两款新车下周上市。

鸿蒙智行 9 月 15 日公布，问界今后的产品定义、设计、品牌营销、渠道零售和服务体系由赛力斯主导，华为继续提供技术赋能。余承东此次的两次表态分别说明了问界分工调整的提出方，以及华为团队后续的资源安排。
title_en: Seres Takes the Lead on Aito as Huawei Shifts Focus to Other EV Brands
content_en:
Richard Yu, head of Huawei's smart car business, has addressed the recent restructuring of the partnership behind the Aito brand. Speaking in Hefei on September 24, Yu revealed that partner automaker Seres actively proposed taking the lead on Aito after years of rapid growth, a move that Huawei fully supported.

Under the new arrangement announced on September 15, Seres will now oversee Aito's product definition, design, marketing, retail, and customer service. Huawei will transition to a supporting role, continuing to provide its core technological empowerment.

With Seres taking the reins of Aito, Huawei's automotive team will redirect its resources to its other four collaborative brands: Maextro, Stelato, Luxeed, and Shangjie. Yu noted that this shift will allow Huawei to dedicate more energy to refining products and user experiences, teasing upcoming launches for Luxeed and design reviews for Maextro's new large SUV.

title_zh: 腾讯 QClaw 将于 12 月 24 日停运，用户可迁移至 WorkBuddy
content_zh:
腾讯旗下 AI 助手 QClaw 9 月 24 日公布停运安排：即日起停止新用户注册、订阅购买和续费，12 月 24 日零时停止运营。现有用户在停运前仍能使用服务，尚未用完的有效付费订阅和积分包可申请退款。

QClaw 将保留备份与迁移入口，用户可以在客户端导出配置、记忆、智能体人格和对话记录，也可通过官网入口将数据迁往腾讯另一款智能体产品 WorkBuddy。停运后至 2027 年 3 月 24 日，用户仍可下载备份；腾讯称届时将依法删除相关用户数据，法定留存信息除外。

腾讯今年 4 月还曾推出 QClaw 海外测试版，产品基于 OpenClaw 框架，可在电脑本地运行并通过手机消息发出远程任务指令。此次公告将调整原因表述为业务发展调整。
title_en: Tencent to Shut Down AI Assistant QClaw in December, Directing Users to WorkBuddy
content_en:
Tencent has announced that its AI assistant QClaw will officially cease operations on December 24, 2024. Effective immediately, the platform has suspended new user registrations, subscriptions, and renewals. Existing users can continue using the service until the shutdown date, and refunds will be available for unused paid subscriptions and points.

To ensure a smooth transition, QClaw is providing data backup and migration tools. Users can export their configurations, memory, agent personas, and chat histories, or directly migrate their data to WorkBuddy, another AI agent product by Tencent. Data downloads will remain accessible until March 24, 2027, after which all user data will be permanently deleted in accordance with privacy laws.

Launched as an overseas beta in April based on the OpenClaw framework, QClaw allowed users to run tasks locally on PCs via mobile commands. Tencent attributed the shutdown to strategic business adjustments.

title_zh: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 上线微信小程序生成和发布能力
content_zh:
腾讯 9 月 24 日为 WorkBuddy 上线微信小程序发布能力。用户在「代码开发」模式中描述需求后，可以生成带云数据库、文件存储及微信授权登录等能力的小程序，并在同一工作台预览、测试和发起发布。腾讯表示，升级至 5.6.1 或更高版本即可使用。

发布时，WorkBuddy 以微信第三方服务商身份接入用户授权的小程序账号，协助上传代码、生成体验版、提交审核和发布正式版。已有小程序账号的用户可以扫码绑定，先在真机测试体验版；没有账号可创建有效期 14 天的试用版，但试用版无法直接转为正式版。

若应用需要保存数据、上传文件或用户登录，WorkBuddy 会提示开通云服务，并在用户确认后接入相应能力。正式版仍需经过微信官方审核。此次更新把此前已支持的网页应用生成，延伸到了微信小程序的构建与上线流程。
title_en: Tencent Upgrades WorkBuddy to Support WeChat Mini Program Creation and Publishing
content_en:
Tencent has upgraded its WorkBuddy platform to allow users to generate and publish WeChat Mini Programs directly through AI. By describing their requirements in "Code Development" mode, users can create fully functional mini-programs integrated with cloud databases, file storage, and WeChat login authorization, all manageable from a single workstation.

Operating as a third-party service provider, WorkBuddy streamlines the deployment process by handling code uploads, generating trial versions, and submitting the final product for WeChat's official review. Users with existing WeChat Mini Program accounts can link them via QR code for real-device testing, while those without can set up a 14-day trial version.

This update expands WorkBuddy's capabilities from web application generation to the WeChat ecosystem. If a mini-program requires backend features like data storage or user authentication, the platform will guide users to activate the necessary cloud services.

title_zh: 豆包回应「对话团队砍半」传闻：只是分工的组织调整
content_zh:
针对「豆包裁员」「对话团队砍掉一半」的说法，豆包公关负责人刘星 9 月 24 日回应称，相关表述不实，此次是通用 Session 团队的分工调整，涉及 11 人，其中 3 人离职。该团队原有规模不到 50 人。

刘星称，部分职能转入豆包交易和豆包工作团队，人员随业务调整，部分人仍在处理原有的对话体验工作。此次回应针对的是团队调整的具体范围；有关人员去向与产品战略，不宜由网传说法推断。
title_en: ByteDance's Doubao Denies Rumors of Halving Its Dialogue Team
content_en:
ByteDance's AI chatbot Doubao has refuted rumors of massive layoffs and claims that its dialogue team was cut in half. Liu Xing, head of public relations for Doubao, clarified on September 24 that the changes were merely routine organizational adjustments.

The restructuring involved the "General Session" team, affecting 11 employees out of a total team size of fewer than 50. Among those affected, only three have left the company.

According to Liu, some roles have been reassigned to the Doubao Transaction and Doubao Work teams to align with business adjustments, while others continue to focus on optimizing the core dialogue experience.

title_zh: 高通续签苹果全球专利授权协议，2027 年 4 月生效
content_zh:
高通 9 月 24 日宣布，已与苹果续签全球专利授权协议，新协议将于 2027 年 4 月 1 日生效。高通技术授权业务负责人 John Han 在公告中确认了续约。

公告针对的是高通的专利授权业务，没有公布续约期限或财务条款，也未把这项协议描述为新的芯片供货安排。高通将专利授权业务与负责处理器等产品业务的子公司分开列示。
title_en: Qualcomm and Apple Renew Global Patent Licensing Agreement
content_en:
Qualcomm announced on September 24 that it has renewed its global patent licensing agreement with Apple. The new agreement is set to take effect on April 1, 2027, securing a continued partnership between the two tech giants.

John Han, head of Qualcomm's technology licensing business, confirmed the extension. However, the announcement did not disclose the specific duration of the extension or any financial terms.

The agreement strictly covers patent licensing and does not represent a new chip supply arrangement. Qualcomm maintains a clear distinction between its licensing business and its semiconductor product division.

title_zh: Google 下周将把 TPU 送入轨道，测试太空运行条件
content_zh:
昨天，Google 公布 Project Suncatcher 的首次轨道测试计划：与卫星公司 Planet 合作，把搭载 TPU 的原型卫星送上 SpaceX 的 Transporter-18 拼车任务。谷歌称发射安排在下周，任务重点是收集芯片经历发射振动、太空辐射与温度变化后的运行数据。

谷歌已在地面做过振动、质子束辐射和热真空测试。其公布的初步结果显示，Trillium TPU 承受的总电离辐射剂量超过模拟五年太空任务所需的水平；真正的散热与长期稳定性仍待轨道数据验证。卫星上的计算设备无法靠空气流动散热，团队正在测试热管和辐射器组合。

Project Suncatcher 于去年公布，目标是研究太阳能供电的卫星群承载 AI 计算的可行性。谷歌计划在 2027 年再测试两颗卫星之间的激光高速连接。
title_en: Google to Launch TPU into Orbit Next Week for Space-Based AI Testing
content_en:
Google has announced the first orbital test for Project Suncatcher, its initiative to explore space-based AI computing. In partnership with satellite company Planet, Google plans to launch a prototype satellite equipped with its Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) next week aboard SpaceX’s Transporter-18 rideshare mission.

The primary objective of the mission is to gather real-world data on how the chip performs under extreme conditions, including launch vibrations, cosmic radiation, and severe temperature fluctuations.

While ground tests show that Google's Trillium TPU can withstand radiation levels equivalent to a five-year space mission, in-orbit data is crucial to verify long-term stability and thermal management. Since air cooling is impossible in space, the team is testing a specialized combination of heat pipes and radiators.

Launched last year, Project Suncatcher aims to assess the feasibility of using solar-powered satellite constellations for AI workloads. Google also plans to test high-speed laser connections between two satellites in 2027.

title_zh: 💡 Jeffrey Ding：AI 领先要看普及应用，而非模型首发
content_zh:
《纽约客》9 月 24 日刊发张澈的文章，采访乔治华盛顿大学政治学者 Jeffrey Ding，讨论中美 AI 竞争中的「先发」观念。Ding 指出，美国在钢铁、电力、化工和汽车四个行业成为领先经济体时，其企业首创的关键创新不到三分之一；一项技术进入企业、公共机构和日常流程的程度，比首发时间更能决定经济收益。

他以电力发展为例：英国研究者率先取得重要发明，美国随后更快建设发电和供电网络。Ding 在访谈中说，若只比较谁拥有最先进模型，会忽略 AI 扩散到整个经济体之后产生的生产率变化。

对 AI 安全，Ding 以 1979 年美国三里岛核事故之后核电建设放缓作类比。他认为技术要赢得公众信任才能普及，优先提高 AI 系统的可靠性，与扩大采用并不冲突。

他主张美国把更多资源投向社区学院、职业学校和州立大学，培养会把 AI 用进地方银行和市政部门的人才。Ding 认为，中国的「人工智能＋」政策强调工厂、医院和行政服务；美国在云计算投入与采用上仍有优势。他也提出，美国企业应正视中国开放权重模型已进入本土开发者和企业工具链的现实。
title_en: AI Leadership Lies in Adoption, Not Just Model Debuts, Says Scholar Jeffrey Ding
content_en:
In a recent interview with *The New Yorker*, George Washington University political scientist Jeffrey Ding challenged the conventional wisdom on the US-China AI race, arguing that technology diffusion and adoption are far more critical to economic leadership than being the first to launch cutting-edge models.

Ding pointed out that when the US became the world's leading economy across key industries like steel, electricity, chemicals, and automobiles, its companies accounted for less than a third of the pioneering innovations. Using electricity as an analogy, he noted that while British researchers made the initial breakthroughs, the US succeeded by rapidly building out generation and distribution networks. Focusing solely on who has the most advanced model overlooks the massive productivity gains that occur when AI is integrated across the broader economy.

Addressing AI safety, Ding compared the current climate to the slowdown in nuclear power development following the 1979 Three Mile Island accident. He emphasized that technology must win public trust to achieve widespread adoption, meaning that prioritizing AI reliability actually supports, rather than hinders, its proliferation.

To maintain its edge, Ding suggested the US invest more in community colleges, vocational schools, and state universities to train a workforce capable of implementing AI in local banks and municipal departments. While China's "AI+" initiative aggressively targets factories, hospitals, and administrative services, the US still holds an advantage in cloud computing investment and adoption. However, Ding warned that US firms must acknowledge the reality that Chinese open-weight models are already deeply integrated into local developer and enterprise toolchains.

title_zh: 谷歌推出 Gemini 3.8 Live Avatar，面向企业提供实时 AI 虚拟形象
content_zh:
谷歌 9 月 24 日发布 Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar，并已在 Gemini Enterprise 提供。它把实时对话与低延迟视频生成结合，让虚拟形象在听取语音、处理画面信息时同步回应，嘴型与表情会随对话变化。

谷歌展示的场景包括客户服务和交互式讲解。系统可以在持续对话时异步调用工具，处理后台查询；官方称，它能在 97 种语言之间切换并同步调整嘴型。企业可以选用预设形象，依据参考图定制形象的能力目前只向获准客户开放。生成的音视频带有 SynthID 水印。
title_en: Google Launches Gemini 3.8 Live Avatar for Real-Time Enterprise Virtual Assistants
content_en:
Google has officially released "Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar," now available to Gemini Enterprise users. The new tool combines real-time conversation with low-latency video generation, enabling virtual avatars to respond synchronously while listening to voice inputs and processing visual information. The avatar's facial expressions and lip movements dynamically adjust to match the dialogue.

Designed for customer service and interactive presentations, the system can asynchronously call background tools to handle queries during an ongoing conversation. Google claims the AI avatars can seamlessly switch between 97 languages while maintaining precise lip-syncing.

While businesses can choose from a variety of preset avatars, the ability to customize avatars using reference images is currently restricted to approved customers. To ensure safety and traceability, all generated audio and video content will be watermarked using Google's SynthID.

title_zh: 9999 元，尼康发布 Z5IIC 全画幅相机
content_zh:
尼康 9 月 24 日发布 Z5IIC 全画幅无反相机。它沿用 Z5II 的影像平台，搭载背照式 CMOS 与 EXPEED 7 处理器，机身模式转盘首次在尼康全画幅无反相机中加入场景模式，可按拍摄对象自动调整色彩和亮度等设置。

机身设有直达尼康与创作者预设配方的专用按键，还加入产品展示模式：把物品移到镜头前时，相机会将焦点切换到物品。视频规格包括最高 4K 60 帧及全高清 120 帧录制，并支持通过 USB 连接电脑用作网络摄像头。
title_en: Nikon Unveils Z5IIC Full-Frame Mirrorless Camera Priced at 9,999 RMB
content_en:
Nikon has officially launched the Z5IIC full-frame mirrorless camera, priced at 9,999 RMB. Built on the Z5II imaging platform, the new camera features a back-illuminated CMOS sensor paired with the powerful EXPEED 7 processor. Notably, it is the first Nikon full-frame mirrorless camera to feature scene modes directly on the physical mode dial, allowing the camera to automatically optimize color, brightness, and other settings based on the subject.

Designed with creators in mind, the Z5IIC includes a dedicated button for quick access to Nikon and creator picture presets. It also introduces a "Product Showcase" mode, which automatically shifts focus to any object brought close to the lens—a highly requested feature for vloggers and reviewers.

For video capabilities, the camera supports up to 4K recording at 60 fps and Full HD at 120 fps. Additionally, users can connect the camera directly to a computer via USB to use it as a high-quality webcam without requiring extra software.

title_zh: 第二代乐奇 AI 眼镜数贸会首秀，新增构图辅助与通话翻译
content_zh:
9 月 24 日，乐奇 Rokid 在杭州第五届全球数字贸易博览会上首次展示第二代带显示屏的 AI 眼镜。新款延续拍摄、翻译、提词、导航和支付等功能，正式发布定于 10 月 27 日，销售计划将在届时公布。

影像方面，新眼镜加入拍摄构图框，并升级防抖与暗光拍摄；翻译功能新增双向对话与通话翻译，可通过蓝牙接收电话另一端的声音，将译文实时显示在镜片上。语音交互支持自定义唤醒词，AI 助手也可根据场景主动提醒。

同场，乐奇展示了面向旅行团的多语言导览：同一位导游讲解时，不同游客可在眼镜中接收各自语言的字幕与译音。公司还发布面向工业现场的 AIOS「灵眸 Rvis」，用于连接巡检流程、知识库与远程专家协作。
title_en: Rokid Debuts Second-Gen AI Glasses with Real-Time Call Translation and Upgraded Camera
content_en:
On September 24, Rokid debuted its second-generation AI glasses with an integrated display at the 5th Global Digital Trade Expo in Hangzhou. The official launch is scheduled for October 27, when sales details will be announced.

The upgraded glasses feature enhanced photography capabilities, including a composition frame, improved image stabilization, and better low-light performance. For translation, the device now supports two-way dialogue and real-time call translation, which streams audio via Bluetooth and projects translated text directly onto the lenses. Additionally, the voice interaction system now supports custom wake words and proactive AI-driven reminders.

At the event, Rokid also demonstrated a multi-language tour guide system that allows tourists to receive real-time subtitles and audio translations in their respective languages from a single guide. Furthermore, the company introduced "Rvis," an industrial-focused AIOS designed to streamline inspection processes, integrate knowledge bases, and facilitate remote expert collaboration.

title_zh: 腾讯正式发布 TenPayGo，面向境外来华用户扫码支付
content_zh:
腾讯 9 月 24 日在深圳宣布正式发布 TenPayGo，这款独立 App 面向境外来华用户，可在支持微信支付的商户使用。腾讯此前已在小范围测试该应用，此次发布明确了面向入境场景的产品定位。

用户可在应用中查看交易记录，支付场景覆盖购物、餐饮、交通、酒店和景点等。腾讯介绍，产品支持境外银行卡及部分境外钱包；面向深圳公共交通的交通卡包仍在测试推进中。

TenPayGo 与现有微信内绑定国际银行卡、境外钱包扫码等入境支付方式并行。对来华用户而言，新入口将付款和本地生活服务放在单独的应用中。
title_en: Tencent Launches Standalone 'TenPayGo' App to Simplify Payments for Inbound Travelers
content_en:
Tencent officially launched "TenPayGo" on September 24 in Shenzhen. The standalone app is designed specifically for international visitors to China, allowing them to make QR code payments at merchants that accept WeChat Pay.

The app enables users to track transaction histories across various scenarios, including shopping, dining, transportation, hotels, and tourist attractions. It supports international bank cards and select overseas e-wallets. Additionally, a transit card feature for Shenzhen's public transportation system is currently undergoing testing.

TenPayGo operates alongside existing inbound payment solutions, such as linking international cards directly within WeChat or using compatible overseas e-wallets. For international travelers, this new app provides a dedicated, streamlined portal that combines payment functions with local lifestyle services.

title_zh: 清华团队公开 Puro-2B 训练方案：估算 4400 美元可达 Qwen2-1.5B 水平
content_zh:
清华大学团队公开了 Puro-2B 的模型权重、训练代码、数据与配置，试图让普通研究团队复现十亿参数级模型的预训练。魔搭社区近日介绍，这组约 20 亿参数的模型从随机初始化训练，在消费级 RTX 5090 集群上最多使用 1.4 万亿 token。相关论文最早于 8 月 27 日提交，并非 9 月的新模型首发。

研究团队用训练成本与 15 项任务的平均成绩拟合经验曲线，估算约 4400 美元的计算预算可达到 Qwen2-1.5B 的成绩；成本低于 6900 美元的最佳版本在其评测口径下接近 Qwen2.5-1.5B。4400 美元是这套硬件租用和实验配置下的计算成本估算，不能等同于购买显卡或完整研发的总费用。

团队采用 FP8 低精度训练、针对 RTX 5090 的通信和并行优化，以及分阶段的数据配方。模型与训练材料已通过开放仓库提供，研究者可以检查训练细节和评测方法。
title_en: Tsinghua Team Open-Sources Puro-2B: Replicating Billion-Parameter LLM Training for $4,400
content_en:
A research team from Tsinghua University has open-sourced the model weights, training code, data, and configurations for "Puro-2B." The release aims to help standard research teams replicate the pre-training process of billion-parameter language models. The 2-billion-parameter model was trained from scratch using up to 1.4 trillion tokens on a consumer-grade RTX 5090 GPU cluster.

By mapping training costs against average performance across 15 tasks, the team estimates that a computing budget of approximately $4,400 can train a model to match the performance of Qwen2-1.5B. A higher-tier version costing under $6,900 approaches the performance of Qwen2.5-1.5B under their evaluation framework. The team noted that these figures represent estimated computing costs based on hardware rentals and experimental configurations, rather than the total cost of purchasing hardware or overall R&D.

To achieve these efficiencies, the team utilized FP8 low-precision training, communication and parallelization optimizations tailored for the RTX 5090, and a phased data recipe. All models and training materials have been made available in open repositories for researchers to inspect and verify.

title_zh: 国庆期间 7 座及以下小客车免收收费公路通行费
content_zh:
交通运输部副部长李扬 9 月 24 日在国新办发布会上介绍，今年国庆假期继续对 7 座及以下小客车免收收费公路通行费。免费时段从 10 月 1 日 0 时至 10 月 7 日 24 时，共七天。

苏州市交通运输局同日的出行提示也明确，9 月 25 日至 27 日的中秋假期不在免费范围内。高速公路免费时间按车辆驶离出口收费车道的时间计算；10 月 8 日 0 时起恢复收费。
title_en: China to Waive Highway Tolls for Small Passenger Cars During National Day Holiday
content_en:
China will waive highway toll fees for passenger vehicles with seven seats or fewer during the upcoming National Day holiday, according to Li Yang, Vice Minister of Transport, at a press conference on September 24.

The toll-free period will run for seven days, starting from midnight on October 1 and ending at midnight on October 7. 

Local transport authorities have reminded motorists that the toll-free status is calculated based on the time the vehicle exits the toll lane, rather than when it enters. Normal toll collection will resume at midnight on October 8.

title_zh: 智元与长隆具身智能主题乐园开园，超 300 台机器人上岗
content_zh:
智元与长隆集团合作的具身智能主题乐园 9 月 24 日在珠海横琴长隆飞船乐园开园。双方此前公布，园区将部署超过 300 台机器人，设置 100 多个互动点，覆盖导览、科普、演艺、零售、酒店和体育等场景。

机器人在导览区可提供路线查询和讲解，在科普区参与知识问答，在零售与酒店区承担接待和咨询。开园活动展示了机器人与人共同表演的舞蹈和机器人空中表演；这些是园区的演出项目，与日常服务场景分开。

长隆与智元于 8 月签署合作协议，计划把机器人互动融入园区巡游、科普讲解和酒店服务。此次开园让此前公布的合作进入实际运营阶段。
title_en: Agibot and Chimelong Launch Embodied AI Theme Park with Over 300 Robots
content_en:
An embodied AI theme park, co-developed by Agibot and Chimelong Group, officially opened at the Zhuhai Hengqin Chimelong Spaceship Park on September 24. This launch marks the operational phase of a strategic partnership signed between the two companies in August.

The park features over 300 robots deployed across more than 100 interactive spots. These robots are integrated into various scenarios, including tour guiding, science education, retail, hotel services, and sports. They are capable of handling route inquiries, answering science trivia, and managing reception desks.

During the opening ceremony, the park showcased specialized entertainment programs, including coordinated robot dances and aerial performances, which will run separately from the robots' daily service duties.

title_zh: 《欢乐合唱团》重启版剧本写成，瑞恩·墨菲已联系原班演员
content_zh:
《欢乐合唱团》主创瑞恩·墨菲接受 Entertainment Tonight 采访时透露，他已与布拉德·法尔查克、伊恩·布伦南写好重启版剧本，并联系约 10 名原班演员。墨菲说，演员们对想法表示热情，也提出了许多问题。

他同时说明，剧本尚未交给演员阅读，项目接下来会如何推进仍待确定。饰演瑞秋的莉娅·米歇尔此前表示愿意回归，但目前没有确定的演员阵容或播出时间。

原版《欢乐合唱团》于 2009 年开播，以高中合唱团为中心，播出六季。此次新进展是核心编剧完成了剧本并开始与原班演员沟通。
title_en: 'Glee' Reboot Script Complete as Creator Ryan Murphy Contacts Original Cast
content_en:
*Glee* creator Ryan Murphy has revealed that a script for a potential reboot of the hit musical series has been written. Speaking to *Entertainment Tonight*, Murphy shared that he co-wrote the script with co-creators Brad Falchuk and Ian Brennan, and has already reached out to approximately 10 members of the original cast.

While the actors have expressed enthusiasm and raised various questions, they have not yet read the script. Murphy emphasized that the project's future steps remain undecided, and there is currently no confirmed cast or release schedule.

The original *Glee*, which centered on a high school show choir, premiered in 2009 and ran for six seasons. This latest update marks the first major step toward a revival, with the core creative team initiating talks with the original stars.

title_zh: 《生化危机：爆发夜》内地定档 10 月 5 日，预售已开启
content_zh:
电影《生化危机：爆发夜》9 月 24 日宣布于 10 月 5 日在中国内地上映，预售同步开启，并发布新版定档预告。《生化危机》系列电影因此时隔九年重返内地院线。

影片由《凶器》导演扎克·克雷格执导，奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯饰演医疗速递员布莱恩。故事发生在浣熊市：布莱恩在送货途中卷入生化危机，必须躲避变异怪物并寻找求援方式。发行方介绍，影片将提供 IMAX、CINITY、中国巨幕、4DX 和 SCREENX 等放映版本。
title_en: ‘Resident Evil: Outbreak Night’ Set for October 5 China Release, Marking Franchise's Return After 9 Years
content_en:
The upcoming sci-fi horror film *Resident Evil: Outbreak Night* is scheduled to hit theaters in mainland China on October 5, with pre-sales officially launching on September 24 alongside a new trailer. This release marks the *Resident Evil* franchise's highly anticipated return to Chinese cinemas after a nine-year hiatus.

Directed by Zach Cregger (*Barbarian*) and starring Austin Abrams as Brian, a medical courier, the film is set in the infamous Raccoon City. The plot follows Brian as he gets caught in a sudden biohazard outbreak during a routine delivery, forcing him to dodge mutated monsters while desperately searching for a way to call for help.

According to the distributor, the film will be available in multiple premium formats, including IMAX, CINITY, China Giant Screen, 4DX, and SCREENX, offering audiences an immersive survival horror experience.
